# Zebral Salon

> Natural hair, color & wig studio based in Bloomington, Indiana. Ayana Brown's one-on-one studio on South Walnut: natural and curly hair, silk presses, custom color, precision cuts, extensions and custom wigs, for every hair texture.

- Phone: (317) 529-2152

## Services
- Natural & curly hair: Wash and sets, blowouts, twists, comb coils, locs and microloc care from someone who knows curls.
- Silk press & smoothing: Moisturizing wash, scalp massage, blow-dry and a steam-straightened silk press that moves.
- Custom color: Bold reds, copper, blues and soft blondes, plus balayage, highlights and color correction.
- Precision cuts: Detailed, thorough cuts and trims that keep curly and straight hair healthy and in shape.
- Extensions & sew-ins: Custom-colored extensions, sew-ins, quick weaves, tape-ins, microlinks and ponytails.
- Wigs & installs: Custom-made wigs, bald-cap installs and wig wash and styling, laid to look like your own.

## About
Zebral Salon is Ayana Brown's studio at 3900-D S Walnut St in Bloomington. In her words, it's a multicultural hair and wig sanctuary: natural hair, silk presses, custom color, precision haircuts, custom-colored K-tip extensions, sew-ins, quick weaves and custom wigs, backed by more than 30 years of experience. Every appointment is one-on-one. Ayana listens first, asks what you love about your hair, and explains what she's doing as she goes. Clients leave with the look they asked for and with tips to keep their hair healthy at home. For a lot of clients it's the only place in town they trust with natural or curly hair. Some have been in her chair for many years, and families keep coming back too: one mom has brought her daughter in since she was four. The studio's motto says it best: where beauty gets the royal treatment.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do you work with natural and curly hair?
  A: Yes, it's the heart of the studio. Wash and sets, twists, comb coils, silk presses, curly cuts, locs and microloc retightening, all by Ayana.
- Q: How do I book?
  A: Book online through the Zebral Salon booking page or call (317) 529-2152. A non-refundable deposit secures every appointment and goes toward your service.
- Q: What's the cancellation policy?
  A: Please give at least 24 hours' notice to cancel or reschedule. Cancellations inside 24 hours lose the deposit, and arriving more than 15 minutes late may mean rescheduling.
- Q: Do you do kids' hair?
  A: Yes. Some clients have been coming since they were four. Ayana explains everything to kids and parents and makes sure they're comfortable.
- Q: Do you make custom wigs?
  A: Yes. Custom-made wigs start at $1,200 depending on length, density and color. Ayana also does wig installs and wig wash and styling.
- Q: Where are you and when are you open?
  A: 3900-D S Walnut St, Bloomington, IN 47401. Thursday and Friday 9 AM to 3 PM, Saturday 6 AM to 3 PM, by appointment. Check the booking page for open times.
